source: Original deterministic generated noise responses, not measured rooms or hardware samples
algorithm: LCG 1664525/1013904223; bipolar noise; exp(-9.21034*t/duration); last 2% faded to zero; each channel L2 energy 0.45
processing: No direct impulse. Convolver normalization disabled. Input high-pass 220Hz, low-pass 4800Hz. Pre-delay 5–45ms; close/air gains sum to one; return gain 0.55. Optional side width 35%.
runtime: Generated once per module at the shared context sample rate; two bounded buffers; released on owner disposal. No IR downloads.
localExports: artifacts/audio-space/ir-0.18.wav and ir-0.9.wav, stereo PCM16 at 24kHz
